text: DSH AIO Agent（DSH 网页客户端插件）：让你在 DSH 会话中使用 Cursor、Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、CodeBuddy 或 Kimi Code 等本机编码 Agent。插件为每种 Agent 注册独立的模式和模型列表，并把每轮消息交给对应 CLI 或 ACP 进程处理，由 DSH 展示和记录对话。你可以在模型选择器切换模型、继续已有 CLI 会话、从工作区或用户目录选择技能，并查看工具步骤和会话轨迹。适合希望在 DSH 界面统一操作不同编码 Agent 的开发者。需要在运行 DSH 的机器上安装并登录所选 Agent CLI。

Use Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, CodeBuddy, or Kimi Code in DSH. Choose a mode and model; turns run through the local CLI or ACP process and appear with tool steps. Resume CLI sessions and call workspace skills. Install and sign in to the chosen CLI on the DSH machine.
想在 DSH 里直接切换 Cursor、Codex 或其他本机编码 Agent。
DSH 能把我的每轮消息交给已经安装的编程 CLI 处理吗？
我想从 DSH 的模型菜单选择 Claude Code 或 OpenCode 的模型。
怎么在 DSH 里接着上次的本地编码 Agent 会话继续聊？
Can I run my installed coding agent from the DSH session interface?
How can I resume a CLI coding session inside DSH?
DSH AIO Agent 的功能「调用本机编码 Agent」：在六种已集成 Agent 模式中发送消息时，插件把当前轮交给对应 CLI 或 ACP 驱动，并将结果写进 DSH 会话。
DSH AIO Agent 的功能「查看并选择 Agent 模型」：打开 DSH 原生模型选择器即可查看已就绪 CLI 的模型；插件隐藏未安装或未登录的 Agent，并提供可用的推理强度信息。
DSH AIO Agent 的功能「继续已有会话」：使用 /resume 命令选择或指定本机 CLI 会话 ID，后续消息绑定到该会话；也能用 /resume off 清除绑定。
DSH AIO Agent 的功能「从工作区调用技能」：在输入中使用 /技能名时，插件从项目或用户技能目录发现并载入技能内容，再将其加入发给 Agent 的消息。
DSH AIO Agent 的功能「显示工具步骤与流式回复」：Agent 的文本、推理和工具调用会转成 DSH 会话步骤；ACP 更新可按节奏呈现，工具结果结束后记录步骤完成。
能不能让 DSH 继续我在另一工作区启动的 CLI 对话？
Can DSH pass workspace skills to the coding agent I selected?
@cocofhu/dsh-aio-agent 提供命令 /resume off

@cocofhu/dsh-aio-agent README · @cocofhu/dsh-aio-agent：Run sessions in Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, CodeBuddy or Kimi Code from inside DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Each agent appears as a mode in the mode menu, and its models appear in the native model selector. Every turn of such a session runs in the agent CLI on the DSH machine. Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and CodeBuddy run one process per turn in their JSON stream mode (`cursor-agent --print`, `claude -p`, `codex exec --json`, `opencode run --format json`, `codebuddy --print`), which reports token usage and resumes the CLI's own session by id; Kimi Code runs over the [Agent Client Protocol](https://agentclientprotocol.com) (ACP). DSH only renders the conversation and keeps the session log; it never calls its own model for these sessions.
@cocofhu/dsh-aio-agent README · @cocofhu/dsh-aio-agent：

@cocofhu/dsh-aio-agent README · Install：Open **Plugins → Add plugin**, enter `github:cocofhu/dsh-aio-agent`, choose **Install**, then **Enable now**. From a terminal, the same install is:

```sh
dsh plugin add github:cocofhu/dsh-aio-agent
```

A release tarball (`cocofhu-dsh-aio-agent-<version>.tgz`, built with `npm pack`) installs the same way by its path or URL. To upgrade, uninstall the plugin and install the new version; settings stay in the profile.

Then install and sign in to the agents you want, on the machine that runs DSH:

@cocofhu/dsh-aio-agent README · Install：| Agent | Install | Sign in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Cursor | `curl https://cursor.com/install -fsS \| bash` | `cursor-agent login` |
| Claude Code | `npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code` | `claude auth login` |
| Codex | `npm install -g @openai/codex` | `codex login` |
| OpenCode | `npm install -g opencode-ai` | `opencode auth login` |
| CodeBuddy | `npm install -g @tencent-ai/codebuddy-code` | run `codebuddy`, then `/login`; models in `~/.codebuddy/models.json` need no sign-in |
| Kimi Code | `curl -fsSL https://code.kimi.com/kimi-code/install.sh \| bash` | `kimi acp --login` |

@cocofhu/dsh-aio-agent README · Install：An agent that is not installed or not signed in stays out of the model selector instead of showing an error. Its settings page shows the steps above with copy buttons.
@cocofhu/dsh-aio-agent README · Use：The CLI keeps its own conversation context: each turn resumes the CLI session the first turn started, also after a DSH restart.

@cocofhu/dsh-aio-agent README · Use：Type `/` to run a skill from this workspace or your home directory. Skills are read from `.dsh/skills`, `.agents/skills`, `.claude/skills`, `.claude/commands`, `.cursor/skills`, `.codex/skills`, `.opencode/skills`, `.codebuddy/skills` and `.kimi/skills` (project, then the same directories under your home directory). Choosing `/skill-name` highlights the chip and opens its `SKILL.md` in the sidebar. Sending it includes the skill instructions in the prompt the CLI receives, including for an agent that does not scan that directory itself. A skill the CLI loads with its own Skill tool shows as the native expandable skill card.

@cocofhu/dsh-aio-agent README · Use：`/resume` continues a CLI session that already exists on this machine. The popup lists the current workspace first, then other workspaces, with the title, time and a short id. `/resume <session-id>` binds that id directly. Later turns pass it to the CLI (`--resume`, `codex exec resume`, `opencode run --session`, or ACP `session/load` for Kimi Code). DSH keeps its own transcript; it does not copy the CLI's history. After a resume, the transcript shows a resume card, a bar above the composer stays visible with that session's title, and the sidebar title changes to it.
@cocofhu/dsh-aio-agent README · Configure：**Plugins → AIO Agent** lists one switchable component per agent; switching one off removes its mode and its models. **Configure** opens the agent's page:

@cocofhu/dsh-aio-agent README · Configure：- **Status**: ready with its model count, or the install and sign-in steps when DSH cannot start it. **Check again** re-reads it.
- **Default model**: used until a session picks a model.
- **Launch command**: replaces the built-in executable, e.g. `"/opt/Cursor Agent/cursor-agent"` or `/opt/codex --profile work`; options after it are kept. Quote paths that contain spaces.
- **Approve permission requests**: answers the requests the agent sends before acting, such as running a command. On approves, off declines. Actions the agent takes without asking follow its own settings.
@cocofhu/dsh-aio-agent README · Configure：Saved values go to the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` and apply from the next turn, without a reload.

@cocofhu/dsh-aio-agent README · Session log：Every line of a JSON stream is recorded in the session log as `plugin:dsh-aio-agent/stream`, and every ACP frame in both directions as `plugin:dsh-aio-agent/acp`, with secrets redacted. Permission answers are recorded as `plugin:dsh-aio-agent/permission`, and the binding between a DSH session and its CLI session as `plugin:dsh-aio-agent/binding`.

@cocofhu/dsh-aio-agent README · Known limitations：- Codex and OpenCode report each reply and tool call once it is complete, so their text arrives in whole messages rather than token by token.
- A Claude Code, Codex or OpenCode session begun with an earlier version of this plugin, over ACP, continues in a new CLI session; its DSH transcript stays.
- The composer's access mode does not restrict the external agent.
- The status cannot tell an agent that is not installed from one that is not signed in.

@cocofhu/dsh-aio-agent README · Develop：```sh
npm test               # node --test
npm run build:logos    # re-inline assets/provider-logos into lib/client.js
npm pack               # tarball to install through Add plugin for a local trial
```

Tests use the DSH installation on `PATH` (or `DSH_ROOT`) and exercise its real agent loop with controlled CLIs for all six backends. With OpenCode and CodeBuddy installed and `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` set, opt in to live tests for queued turns, queue Send and Stop:

@cocofhu/dsh-aio-agent README · Develop：```sh
DSH_AIO_LIVE_TESTS=1 node --import ./test/dsh-runtime.mjs --test test/live-driver.test.js
```

The live tests use temporary workspaces and CLI configuration; they make billed DeepSeek API calls.

Provider logos come from [lobe-icons](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-icons) (MIT); see `assets/provider-logos/README.md`.
